name: Ark of Baron Auletphant
description: The Ark of Baron Auletphant was an interstellar barge. It was golden and was inlaid with rose and azure mytag crystals. Commissioned more than ten thousand years prior to 520 BBY, the Ark of Baron Auletphant traveled for a century between far-flung worlds. There, the vessel collected specimens of aquatic life.
